code_review_observations: BookingsList.jsx is now ~620 lines and contains four logical components (PropertyAvailabilityCard, RenterBookingsList, OwnerStackedView, BookingsList shell). Consider splitting PropertyAvailabilityCard and OwnerStackedView into their own files for maintainability (approaches the 700-line threshold).

OwnerStackedView has a duplicated fetchAvailability effect: useEffect(...) on mount AND a second useEffect on bookings.length, plus a wrapped handleUpdate that is defined but never actually injected into the actions hook. This causes one extra fetch on first render. The dev comment block (lines ~416-429, ~460-463) acknowledges the workaround — clean this up.

MiniCalendar.dayInfo iterates ALL bookings for every cell of every month — O(days × bookings) per render. With 8 bookings/3 months it's fine, but if a power-host has hundreds of bookings this gets expensive. Pre-index bookings by ISO date once per month.
MiniCalendar uses hardcoded English month label ('en-US' locale on line 38) which inconsistently mixes with Hebrew UI when i18nextLng=he. Use the user's locale or i18n month names.

MiniCalendar.dayInfo uses new Date(year, month, day).toISOString().slice(0,10) — this is timezone-sensitive. For users east of UTC the ISO date can roll back to the previous day. Prefer constructing the YYYY-MM-DD string manually.

STATUS_COLOR in MiniCalendar only covers 'confirmed' and 'pending'; cancellation_requested is filtered IN to liveBookings (BookingsList.jsx:86) but colorFor returns null, so the cell renders with empty bg + 'undefined' style. Add a color for cancellation_requested (e.g., amber) or exclude it from liveBookings.
RenterBookingsList still has 'No bookings match your filter' / 'No bookings yet' as hardcoded English strings — should use t() like the rest of the file.

OwnerStackedView filters bookingsByProp by b.owner_id === user.id but the OwnerStackedView shows availability for ALL properties the user owns — including ones with 0 bookings. This is fine, but the 'myTrips' section will not appear for an owner who also rents elsewhere unless they have non-self-listed bookings. Verified in the UI.
action_items: (MINOR) Add a color entry to MiniCalendar.STATUS_COLOR for 'cancellation_requested' (or exclude it from liveBookings in BookingsList.jsx). Currently those days render with no background.
(MINOR) i18n MiniCalendar month label and the two remaining hardcoded English strings in RenterBookingsList ('No bookings match your filter', 'X booking(s) found').
(MINOR) Replace toISOString().slice(0,10) in MiniCalendar.dayInfo with a TZ-safe local YYYY-MM-DD formatter to avoid off-by-one on positive UTC offsets.
(OPTIONAL) Extract PropertyAvailabilityCard + OwnerStackedView from BookingsList.jsx into their own files; the file is ~620 lines and growing.
(OPTIONAL) Remove the redundant second useEffect on bookings.length and the now-unused handleUpdate wrapper in OwnerStackedView.
